verdict.rationale: Brex offers a broad set of documented REST APIs, including Expenses, Payments, Transactions, Team, Budgets and Accounting, plus webhooks and a quickstart. This lets spend operations be scripted without the UI, and low-code automation is shown through Pipedream and Zapier recipes. Nothing in the evidence addresses running in CI specifically: no CLI, no CI/CD integration docs, and no guidance on headless auth such as service tokens. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, CI pipeline documentation, service-account/token auth guidance for unattended jobs, and independent corroboration of headless automation use.
